name: Chad's Voice Changer
author: Jerry Jewell (JerryJewell)
description: Play FPP sequence audio and a live, voice-changed mic at the same time. Both can share one audio output on compatible setups. Includes clean, robot, and experimental cartoon presets and a Status-page mic switch.

privacy.summary: Processes live microphone audio on this player and outputs it to your amplifier. Audio is not recorded or sent online.

systemChanges.what: Installs and enables fpp-robotvoice.service to run the audio engine as the fpp user at boot.
Installs NumPy and PortAudio from OS repositories and sounddevice 0.5.3 from PyPI through FPP.

privacy.other: Stores device names, effect settings, audio-device status and diagnostic logs under FPP media. Web controls use FPP's existing web server. No audio files are stored.
